name: structural-file-graphing
body: The structural-graphing capability: the text/config/data formats a repository contains, the bundled scanner that turns each into graph nodes, and the residual format that catches whatever the other formats leave unclaimed. This group makes the question "is file X in the graph, and what structure does it carry?" answerable for the non-code surfaces — the packaging, configuration and data files that lie outside the claim of a per-language code frontend.
